items.caption: Modern redraw in a seal-script style, labelled 院 and associated with the transmitted 說文 form. It illustrates a seal-style representation, not an excavated artifact.
items.alt: Black seal-script-style rendering of 院 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: The visible glyph can illustrate the transmitted seal-style form. Its modern redraw status and the disagreement between the transmitted 院 and 寏 analyses mean it cannot establish an early artifact form or resolve their relationship.

limitations.text: No verified early manuscript or artifact image is available here to show 院’s early written form. This modern seal-style redraw does not establish which of the competing transmitted constructions is earlier.
